title: krot-control chart values
description: Validated against the krot-control chart templates. Keys the templates interpolate verbatim are restricted to what renders into a valid manifest; the config map is a passthrough and is not validated beyond being a string map.

quantity.description: Kubernetes resource quantity: a number or a string with an optional suffix (m, Mi, Gi, ...).

stringMap.description: String-to-string map, as required by Kubernetes labels and annotations.

repository.description: Image repository. An empty one renders `image: ":<tag>"`, which the kubelet refuses with InvalidImageName.

tag.description: Rendered verbatim after the ':' separator; empty falls back to .Chart.AppVersion, which is why it may be empty here.

secretName.description: Out-of-band Secret consumed with envFrom alongside the ConfigMap. The key is required; an empty name is refused by the template, because it renders a secretRef the API server refuses.

host.description: Ingress rule host. Required whenever the Ingress renders: an empty host renders a rule the API server refuses.

tlsSecret.description: TLS secret name; empty renders the Ingress without a tls block.

gatewayAPI.description: Gateway API exposure, the alternative to the Ingress: an HTTPRoute attached to an operator-owned Gateway whose listener terminates TLS (the chart creates no certificate).

gatewayName.description: Name of the Gateway the HTTPRoute attaches to. Required whenever the route renders: an empty parentRef name is refused by the template, because the API server requires a name on every parentRef.

gatewayNamespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway; empty renders the parentRef without a namespace, which the Gateway API reads as the HTTPRoute's own namespace.

host.description: Hostname the route serves. Required whenever the route renders: a hostless HTTPRoute matches every host the listener serves, capturing traffic meant for other routes, so the template names the value instead.

databaseTLS.description: PostgreSQL TLS material, projected into the pod at the fixed path /etc/krot/pg-tls and exported as PGSSLROOTCERT/PGSSLMODE (plus PGSSLCERT/PGSSLKEY with a client pair), which pgx reads for the migration and serving connections. The DSN needs no TLS parameters; explicit sslmode/sslrootcert in it win over the environment.

sslmode.description: Exported as PGSSLMODE. verify-full and verify-ca are the modes the mounted CA material supports.

caSecretName.description: Secret holding the CA certificate. Required whenever the volume renders: an empty source name is refused by the template, because the API server requires a name on every projected source.

caKey.description: Key of the CA certificate within caSecretName; projected to the fixed path ca.crt.

clientSecretName.description: Secret holding the client certificate pair; empty omits the client source and the PGSSLCERT/PGSSLKEY exports.

certKey.description: Key of the client certificate within clientSecretName; projected to the fixed path tls.crt.

keyKey.description: Key of the client private key within clientSecretName; projected to the fixed path tls.key.

config.description: Non-secret environment, rendered verbatim into the krot-cp-config ConfigMap. Keys become environment variable names, so they have to be names Kubernetes accepts.
